# Nuxt Minimal — LLM Agent Contract (llm.txt)

> **For LLM agents generating Nuxt + UnoCSS + Pinia UIs.**
> This starter is a lean, zero-bloat Nuxt 3 boilerplate. Follow the rules below strictly.

## 0. Golden Rules

1. **Utility-First CSS:** Use UnoCSS utility classes. Never write custom CSS unless absolutely necessary (e.g., global resets, complex keyframe animations).
2. **No Tailwind Classes:** This project uses **UnoCSS**, not Tailwind. UnoCSS is compatible with most Tailwind syntax, but respect UnoCSS-specific features (attributify, icons, shortcuts).
3. **Icons:** Use `<i class="i-lucide-<name>" />` for all icons. Do not use `<svg>` inline unless the icon is custom.
4. **State Management:** Use Pinia stores from `stores/`. Never use Vuex or local state for shared data.
5. **TypeScript:** All Vue SFCs must use `<script setup lang="ts">`.
6. **No Extra Dependencies:** Do not add new UI libraries (e.g., Headless UI, Vuetify). Style with UnoCSS utilities only.
7. **Single-Page Default:** The starter uses `app.vue`. If multi-route is needed, create `pages/` directory and add routes via `vue-router`.

## 1. Styling (UnoCSS)

### Presets Enabled
- `presetUno` — Standard utilities (flexbox, colors, spacing, typography)
- `presetAttributify` — Class-less utilities via attributes (e.g., `<div bg="red/10 text=white">`)
- `presetIcons` — Icon utilities (e.g., `<i class="i-lucide-plus" />`)
- `presetWebFonts` — Google Fonts (Inter, Fira Code)

### Custom Shortcuts
Defined in `uno.config.ts`:
- `btn` — Base button layout
- `btn-primary` — Emerald primary variant
- `btn-secondary` — Neutral secondary variant
- `card` — Rounded panel with backdrop blur

### Example: Button
```vue
<button class="btn-primary">
  <i class="i-lucide-plus" />
  Add Item
</button>
```

### Example: Card
```vue
<div class="card p-4">
  <h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-neutral-200">Card Title</h2>
  <p class="text-sm text-neutral-400">Card content</p>
</div>
```

### Example: Attributify
```vue
<div bg="neutral-900/60 text=white p=4 rounded=xl">
  Styled via attributes, not classes
</div>
```

## 2. State (Pinia)

### Store Pattern
```ts
// stores/example.ts
export const useExampleStore = defineStore('example', () => {
  const items = ref<string[]>([])
  function addItem(value: string) {
    items.value.push(value)
  }
  return { items, addItem }
})
```

### Usage in Components
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const store = useExampleStore()
</script>

<template>
  <ul>
    <li v-for="item in store.items" :key="item">{{ item }}</li>
  </ul>
  <button class="btn-primary" @click="store.addItem('New')">
    Add
  </button>
</template>
```

## 3. Icons (Lucide)

Use the `<i>` tag with `i-lucide-<name>` classes.

### Examples
```vue
<i class="i-lucide-plus" />       <!-- Plus icon -->
<i class="i-lucide-x" />          <!-- Close icon -->
<i class="i-lucide-settings" />   <!-- Settings icon -->
```

### Sizing & Color
```vue
<i class="i-lucide-plus text-lg text-emerald-400" />
```

## 4. Routing (Optional)

If multi-route is needed:
1. Create `pages/` directory.
2. Add `.vue` files (e.g., `pages/about.vue`).
3. Routes are auto-generated via `vue-router`.

### Example: `pages/about.vue`
```vue
<template>
  <div class="p-6">
    <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold">About</h1>
    <NuxtLink to="/" class="text-emerald-400">← Home</NuxtLink>
  </div>
</template>
```

## 5. Common Patterns

### Form Input
```vue
<input
  v-model="name"
  type="text"
  placeholder="Your name"
  class="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
/>
```

### Modal
```vue
<dialog class="p-6 rounded-xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800">
  <h2 class="text-lg font-semibold mb-4">Title</h2>
  <p>Content</p>
  <button class="btn-secondary mt-4" @click="dialog.close()">Close</button>
</dialog>
```

### Table
```vue
<table class="w-full text-sm">
  <thead>
    <tr class="text-left text-neutral-500 border-b border-neutral-800">
      <th class="py-2">Name</th>
      <th class="py-2">Role</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr class="border-b border-neutral-900 hover:bg-neutral-900/50">
      <td class="py-2 text-white">John</td>
      <td class="py-2 text-neutral-400">Admin</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

## 6. Constraints

- **No CSS Frameworks:** UnoCSS only. No Tailwind, Bootstrap, or custom CSS files.
- **No UI Libraries:** No Vuetify, Quasar, or Headless UI.
- **No Global Styles:** Use `<style>` only for global resets (e.g., `body { margin: 0; }`).
- **No Custom Directives:** Use standard Vue directives (`v-if`, `v-for`, `v-model`).
- **No Server-Side Rendering (SSR) Issues:** Ensure components are SSR-safe (no `window`/`document` in setup without `onMounted`).

## 7. Validation Checklist

Before submitting code, verify:
- [ ] All classes are valid UnoCSS utilities or shortcuts.
- [ ] All icons use `i-lucide-*` format.
- [ ] All state is in Pinia stores (if shared).
- [ ] All SFCs use `<script setup lang="ts">`.
- [ ] No custom CSS unless necessary.
- [ ] No new dependencies added.
- [ ] Build passes: `bun build`.
